name: confetti
title: 彩纸庆祝
description: 包含七种发射方式的 Canvas 彩纸庆祝效果。

files.content:
.jui-confetti { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }

.jui-confetti[data-fullscreen="true"] { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100dvh; z-index: 9999; pointer-events: none; }
